title: Country Boundary Downloader: Full Outlines
description: Download a matched country polygon from a fixed country list as KML or GeoJSON; verify its coverage.
summary_sentence: The returned OSM outline may contain multiple polygon parts; check the match and coverage.
quick_answer: Choose one of the listed countries to retrieve the first polygon match from Nominatim, download its geometry, and see an approximate spherical area. This is not an official land-area figure.

body.t: Use the matched outline for a map or report after checking its source and geographic coverage.

faq: The selector has a fixed list of 24 countries, not every country. A polygon match is not guaranteed.
Coverage follows the returned feature; verify whether a territory is included independently.
KML for Google Earth and sharing; GeoJSON for GIS, web maps and code. Same outline in both — choose by destination, not by data.
Why is the file so large?
Coastlines are fractal in spirit: detailed countries carry hundreds of thousands of outline points. Size is fidelity. Simplify in your GIS if your use allows it.
Can I get just one island or region?
Use the Boundary KML Downloader for sub-national outlines — provinces, states and islands with their own administrative records live there.
Holes in the returned polygon geometry are exported, but their presence depends on the matched OSM record.
OpenStreetMap’s documented position, as with all boundary data here. The file is a working geometry, not a diplomatic ruling.
